title: LEMMA-RCA: A Large Multi-modal Multi-domain Dataset for Root Cause Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2406.05375v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) is crucial for enhancing the reliability and performance of complex systems. However, progress in this field has been hindered by the lack of large-scale, open-source datasets tailored for RCA. To bridge this gap, we introduce LEMMA-RCA, a large dataset designed for diverse RCA tasks across multiple domains and modalities. LEMMA-RCA features various real-world fault scenarios from Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems, including microservices, water distribution, and water treatment systems, with hundreds of system entities involved. We evaluate the performance of six baseline methods on LEMMA-RCA across various settings, including offline and online models, as well as single and multi-modal settings. Our study demonstrates the utility of LEMMA-RCA in facilitating fair evaluation and promoting the development of more robust RCA techniques. The dataset is publicly available at ht

translated_title: LEMMA-RCA：一个用于根因分析的大规模多模态多领域数据集
translated_abstract: 根因分析（RCA）对于提升复杂系统的可靠性和性能至关重要。然而，该领域的进展一直受到缺乏针对RCA的大规模开源数据集的阻碍。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了LEMMA-RCA，这是一个专为跨多个领域和模态的多样化RCA任务设计的大型数据集。LEMMA-RCA包含了来自信息技术（IT）和运营技术（OT）系统的各种真实故障场景，包括微服务、供水系统和水处理系统，涉及数百个系统实体。我们在LEMMA-RCA上评估了六种基线方法在不同设置下的性能，包括离线和在线模型，以及单模态和多模态设置。我们的研究证明了LEMMA-RCA在促进公平评估和推动更稳健RCA技术发展方面的实用性。该数据集可在以下网址公开获取：ht
tldr: 本文提出了LEMMA-RCA，一个覆盖IT和OT系统多领域多模态的大规模根因分析数据集，旨在填补该领域缺乏开源基准的空白，并验证了其支持多种评估设置的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LEMMA-RCA, a large-scale multi-domain multi-modal dataset for root cause analysis across IT and OT systems, addressing the lack of open-source benchmarks and demonstrating its utility in diverse evaluation settings.
